answer: A raven beacon publishes an unpredictable challenge each round, and each agent must reply with a signal from its own prior verified work within a 30-second delta. Agents are randomly paired to cross-check signals, so n identities need about n-squared pairwise checks plus n live responses, while reward per identity stays flat. Clones reusing one history give correlated signals and are slashed together. One honest agent pays only one response and a few checks.
